tvShow.name: One Hundred Years of Solitude
tvShow.overview: In the mythical town Macondo, seven generations of the Buendía family navigate love, oblivion and the inescapability of their past — and their fate.

episodes.name: Macondo
episodes.overview: Fearing a ghost and a curse, Úrsula and José Arcadio leave their town to establish a new home along a few others, braving a journey through tough terrain.

episodes.name: It's Like an Earthquake
episodes.overview: Aureliano has visions of a war, while José Arcadio Jr. meets a woman. José Arcadio's alchemy obsession pushes Ursula to find a way to support the family.

episodes.name: A Daguerreotype of God
episodes.overview: An odd girl brings a delirious sickness to Macondo. José Arcadio becomes fascinated by Melquiades' camera. Rebeca and Amaranta vie for Pietro's attention.

episodes.name: The Chestnut Tree
episodes.overview: A new mayor and his family settle in Macondo. Aureliano experiences love for the first time, while a death drives José Arcadio into madness.

episodes.name: Remedios Moscote
episodes.overview: Arcadio becomes the school's principal, and Pilar has significant news for Aureliano. Remedios fills the Buendía home with joy — until tragedy strikes.

episodes.name: Colonel Aureliano Buendía
episodes.overview: José Arcadio Jr. returns, shocking everyone with his wild nature, specially Rebecca. Amid political unrest, Aureliano becomes a revolutionary leader.

episodes.name: Arcadio and the Liberal Paradise
episodes.overview: Arcadio enforces liberal rule in Macondo, while Aureliano attempts to free a colonel from the conservatives. The looming threat of war finally arrives.

episodes.name: So Many Flowers Fell from the Sky
episodes.overview: Years later, when Aureliano reveals his war plans for Macondo, a heartbroken Ursula comes to a shocking realization about her family.

episodes.name: The Armistice
episodes.overview: Identical in looks but different in fates, Aureliano Segundo and Jose Arcadio Segundo forge their own paths as Col. Aureliano decides the world's fate.

episodes.name: The Queen of Madagascar
episodes.overview: Macondo is mesmerized by a new beauty — but everything that blooms must wilt. Aureliano Segundo meets Petra, who unknowingly wanders between two men.

episodes.name: Fernanda Del Carpio
episodes.overview: Aureliano Segundo is enamored with Fernanda del Carpio but falls into old ways. A deal is struck. The colonel is honored as the 17 Aurelianos gather.

episodes.name: The Innocent Train Had Arrived
episodes.overview: A new railway connects Macondo to the outside world, but as foreigners settle in, a cruel reality sets in. The Buendías witness a miraculous vanishing.

episodes.name: It Was October 11
episodes.overview: Upon her return, sparks fly between Meme and Mauricio Babilonia. As love and heat blossom between them, so does Fernanda's rage. A mutiny brews.

episodes.name: More than Three Thousand of Them
episodes.overview: Tensions between farmhands and United Fruit Co. break into an all-out massacre that devastates Macondo, its residents and José Arcadio Segundo.

episodes.name: It Rained for Four Years, Eleven Months and Two Days
episodes.overview: Macondo's death blow takes shape as Fernanda hides another secret, and Úrsula gives her descendants a dire warning. The twins' fate entwines once again.

episodes.name: One Hundred Years of Solitude
episodes.overview: Aureliano Babilonia and Amaranta Úrsula revel in their rotting paradise. After a century and a birth, a cursed lineage is erased and forgotten.

reviews.author: Leonsaaharat
reviews.content:
"Many people say this movie is different from the book. However, as a Thai person who isn't familiar with Latin American culture, I found it impossible to imagine the types of characters Márquez intended to write. Watching this film helped me understand the political philosophy behind Benedict Anderson’s definition of society in Imagined Communities."
"If you want to know what kind of society people desire, try sharing a book with that community; you will begin to see the collective imagination of its people."
